name: tally
description: Tally — Your Private Training & Body Log

scripts.check: tsc -p . && node build/check-layers.mjs && node build/check-names.mjs && node build/build.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && node tests/equiv.mjs && node tests/estimate.mjs && node tests/storage.mjs && node tests/copyday.mjs && node tests/tour.mjs && node tests/fold.mjs && node tests/plates.mjs && node tests/coachapply.mjs && node tests/chartpick.mjs && node tests/headroom.mjs && node tests/routines.mjs && node tests/record.mjs old && node tests/record.mjs new && node tests/compare.mjs old new
scripts.release: npm run check && cp dist/index.html index.html && cp dist/sw.js sw.js
